sourceCaveats: Pinned Overseer serializes its anonymous object using default System.Text.Json options.
Nested DTO properties therefore preserve PascalCase unless changed elsewhere.
The pinned creature DTO and manager disagree about Hunger and IsAfraid properties.
Direct serialization of the multidimensional corruption grid is not verified and may fail.
Local worktree changes add a camel-case serializer path but remain untracked/uncommitted in the submodule.
requiredActions: Do not assume BroadcastState has successfully emitted a valid JSON frame.
Keep world identity, tick ownership, and timestamp sourcing explicit.
Validate complete snapshots before a future transport publishes them.
